snippet.title: When Stars Align - Display 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
When Stars Align is a story-driven single-player 3D platformer for PC and consoles where players, as the embodiment of a fallen star, explore a dreamlike island with the help of a magical companion. By solving puzzles, helping islanders, and collecting lost star fragments, players gradually uncover the island’s hidden stories and restore the night sky and themselves.

Created by students of the games master program at the University of Applied Sciences Hamburg.

Download on itch.io
https://heartdrivengames.itch.io/when-stars-align
